% Layout note (thesis step 6f). THESIS_PLAN's locked page band [195, 230]
% was estimated for a standard thesis layout; the original
% 11pt/margin=2.6cm/single-spaced layout rendered the SAME content ~40%
% denser and could not reach the band with any honest amount of material.
% Adopted here: 12pt, 3.2 cm margins, 1.25 leading — the conventional
% thesis format, satisfying Part 0.1's "generous margins" and the locked
% band at once. (12pt supersedes the plan-body "11pt" line; the band is
% the locked decision.) Revert = this block + the two lines below.

% Placeholder for a user-supplied engine render (THESIS_PLAN Part 1c):
% carries the exact reproducing command so the figure stays reproducible.
\newcommand{\renderpending}[2]{%
  \begin{figure}[ht]\centering
  \fbox{\begin{minipage}{0.8\textwidth}\centering\vspace{1.0cm}
  \itshape Engine render pending\\[4pt]
  \normalfont\ttfamily\footnotesize #2
  \vspace{1.0cm}\end{minipage}}%
  \caption{\itshape [Placeholder] #1 Reproduced by the command shown;
  the render will be slotted in when supplied.}%
  \end{figure}%
}

% "Terms you just met" summary box for the Part I primer chapters

  \noindent\textbf{Terms you just met.}\begin{description}
  \setlength{\itemsep}{1pt}}%
  {\end{description}\medskip\hrule\end{minipage}\par\medskip}

% Worked-example box for the primer (plan: expand primer worked examples)
\newenvironment{worked}[1]{%
  \par\medskip\noindent\begin{minipage}{\textwidth}
  \rule{\textwidth}{0.4pt}\par\smallskip
  \noindent\textbf{Worked example: #1}\par\smallskip\small}%
  {\par\smallskip\rule{\textwidth}{0.4pt}\end{minipage}\par\medskip}
